title: Agent Memory Server
description: Use this when an agent needs durable, searchable memory across sessions — exposes 7 memory_* tools over a single-file SQLite graph store with hybrid recall (vec+BM25+temporal, <50ms, zero LLM), write-enqueue, session state, community lookup, and bi-temporal invalidation.
author: sox-ecosystem

tools.name: memory_ping
tools.description: Use this to verify the server is reachable — returns {ok:true} without touching any database.

tools.name: memory_write
tools.description: Write a memory episode to the store. Returns {episode_uid}. Enqueues organize; never blocks on LLM.

db_path.description: Optional; defaults to the bundle-configured store (host-injected SOX_CONFIG_DB_PATH, seeded by soxe install). With neither, the call fails with E_STORE_NOT_CONFIGURED — the server never infers a path. Path to the SQLite memory store. Must be within ~/.memory/** (the fs allowlist in this extension's permissions block). Paths outside are denied by the host permission guard with no side effects.

tools.name: memory_recall
tools.description: Recall memories using hybrid vec+BM25+temporal search. <50ms, zero LLM. Returns ranked results.

db_path.description: Optional; defaults to the bundle-configured store (host-injected SOX_CONFIG_DB_PATH, seeded by soxe install). With neither, the call fails with E_STORE_NOT_CONFIGURED — the server never infers a path. Path to the SQLite memory store. Must be within ~/.memory/** (the fs allowlist in this extension's permissions block). Paths outside are denied by the host permission guard with no side effects.

tools.name: memory_search_entities
tools.description: Search for entities by name/type. Returns matching entity nodes.

tools.name: memory_get_community
tools.description: Get community node for an entity.

tools.name: memory_invalidate
tools.description: Invalidate a claim (bi-temporal: sets t_invalid, never deletes).

db_path.description: Absolute path to the SQLite memory store file (e.g. ~/.memory/memory.db). REQUIRED: memory-server never infers a store path — without it every store tool returns E_STORE_NOT_CONFIGURED. soxe install seeds it per scope from x-sox-scope-default when unset. ENFORCEMENT NOTE P4/P5: host must sandbox writes to this path (Gap F5 — unsandboxed db_path).

sock_path.description: Unix socket path for memoryd IPC (default: ~/.memory/memoryd.sock).

token_budget.description: Default token budget for memory_recall responses (default: 32000).

activation_posture.description: CONTRACTS §I: read at os-unit generation. always-on → RunAtLoad+KeepAlive; on-demand → socket-activation spec. soxe config set triggers restartOsUnit hook.

transports.description: CONTRACTS §I: which listeners the backend binds simultaneously (TR-1 multi-bind). SSE added by context 04.

http_port.description: CONTRACTS §I: pinned default so generated :3099 URLs are correct-by-construction. Listener AND host-config generation MUST read this key (TR-3, BL-148). Moved off 3000 (a common webapp dev-server port) to 3099 during the 2026-07-04 proxy-mode hardening (BL-155/156/157); this schema default had drifted stale until now.
http_port.x-sox-prompt: Enter HTTP port for MCP server (default: 3099):

bind_address.description: CONTRACTS §I: HTTP bind address. Defaults to loopback. Non-loopback requires auth_token (TR-2).

auth_token.description: CONTRACTS §I: Bearer token for HTTP transport auth. Required when bind_address is non-loopback (TR-2). Env-ref (e.g. ${SOX_MEMORY_TOKEN}) supported.

deep_verify_timeout_ms.description: BL-deepverify: wall-clock bound (ms) for the background out-of-process deep integrity pass (PRAGMA integrity_check) owed after an unclean shutdown. Default 1800000 (30 min). On expiry the verifier is SIGKILLed, the pass is recorded unknown, and memory_ping reads degraded until a later pass completes ok. Tuning only (ADR-0013 D3): no value disables deep verification; a malformed value fails the store open.

mainthread_kill_after_ms.description: BL-deepverify: main-thread silence (ms) after which the off-thread watchdog SIGKILLs the server for the supervisor to restart. Default 300000 (5 min). Tuning only (ADR-0013 D3): no value disables the watchdog; a malformed value fails the boot.
